oneResponsibility.notes: Inherits published 0.3.4 inventory a5e00bd45a1122917e6b164ad98373cdcc043e6c681790495086ee0a2e870182. Three production files changed: ClaimZone reconciles sight only after exact claim projections commit, before seal staging so a pending seal still exposes the committed claim; PublishSecond reconciles after paired topology and exact seat/claim checks. Both calls use the existing guarded, idempotent ReconcileZone and do not turn a presentation failure into a repeated debit. The third file updates comments only. Ownership, master/option gates and duplicate prevention remain centralized in ReconcileZone. No fields, serialization, rendering projection, gameplay LOS or architecture change. Root automated source review; native acceptance is separately recorded in STATUS.md.
